credentialClasses.name: certificates
credentialClasses.overlap: old and new certificates overlap during rollout
credentialClasses.revocation: revoke old certificate after health confirmation
credentialClasses.recovery: restore from managed certificate backup and revalidate trust

credentialClasses.name: signing-keys
credentialClasses.overlap: publish key history before activating the new key
credentialClasses.revocation: mark compromised key revoked in key history
credentialClasses.recovery: recover from offline key escrow with dual control

credentialClasses.name: master-keys
credentialClasses.revocation: disable compromised key version after re-encryption
credentialClasses.recovery: recover from HSM/KMS backup and verify decrypt test

credentialClasses.name: provider-credentials
credentialClasses.overlap: new credential is validated before old credential removal
credentialClasses.revocation: revoke old provider credential immediately after cutover
credentialClasses.recovery: restore secret reference and run provider health check

credentialClasses.name: webhook-secrets
credentialClasses.overlap: dual-signature verification during bounded rotation window
credentialClasses.revocation: remove old secret after consumer confirmation
credentialClasses.recovery: restore encrypted secret version and replay a signed test

credentialClasses.name: service-accounts
credentialClasses.overlap: new account permissions are verified before handoff
credentialClasses.revocation: disable old account and tokens after handoff

credentialClasses.name: api-keys
credentialClasses.overlap: new key is issued before old key expiry
credentialClasses.revocation: revoke old key and retain audit metadata only
credentialClasses.recovery: issue replacement key after owner verification

recoveryDrill: quarterly restore and revocation drill with audit evidence
revocation: all rotations require explicit revocation confirmation and audit correlation
